description: Double track tunnel: a spruce frame every 6 blocks; between frames slab ceiling and, in the middle, a copper lantern on a chain in section A and none in section B.
legend: The track runs along +x, one slice per block; z runs across from the left, middle is the z of the tunnel's middle line, rail_level the y of the rails. air clears, barrier is a wall, structure void leaves the block. cobwebs are across and up from the middle and the rails.
